archive_metadata.provenance_note: Synthetic dataset generated with IMD climatology distributions, seeded physics, and documented NWP regime biases. All results are synthetic.

sources.name: IMD 0.25° daily gridded rainfall
sources.why: The gauge-based analysis IMD and NCMRWF verify against; ~6,900 stations.

sources.name: NCMRWF NCUM-G / NEPS-G
sources.provider: National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting
sources.period: operational archive via NCMRWF data portal
sources.citation: Mittal et al. (2019); Sarkar et al. (2021)
sources.why: The forecast this post-processor is designed to correct in operations.

sources.role: Raw NWP forecast (open archive, Day 1–5 leads)
sources.name: Archived GFS / ECMWF IFS / UK Met Office UM forecasts
sources.provider: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (NOAA, ECMWF, UKMO open data)
sources.resolution: native model grid (9–25 km), hourly → IMD day
sources.why: What each model actually predicted N days ahead — the only free lead-time archive. UKMO UM is the same model family as NCUM-G.

sources.name: ERA5 reanalysis — 850/500 hPa wind, vorticity, humidity, z500, MSLP, CAPE
sources.access: CDS API key · fetch_real_data.py dynamics --era5 (Open-Meteo fallback, no key)
sources.why: Reference analysis for the dynamical state that defines a regime.

sources.name: NOAA Interpolated OLR
sources.access: PSL THREDDS NetCDF Subset (CSV, no key)
sources.why: Standard index of monsoon intraseasonal convection.

sources.name: Core-monsoon-zone index (Rajeevan, Bhate & Jaswal 2010)
sources.provider: IMD criterion, computed from the IMD grid
sources.citation: Rajeevan et al. (2010), J. Earth Syst. Sci. 119:229–247
sources.why: IMD's own operational definition of active and break spells.

sources.name: Districts of India — Census 2011 (641 districts)
sources.why: Official administrative extent used for area-weighted district rainfall.

sources.name: Copernicus GLO-90 DEM
sources.provider: ESA / Airbus via Open-Meteo Elevation API
sources.why: Elevation and slope for the windward-slope criterion.

sources.name: MonsoonIQ physically-parameterised synthetic archive
sources.why: Lets anyone reproduce every number offline; errors are simulated, so skill here is internal consistency, not operational skill.

how_to_switch: python scripts/fetch_real_data.py all  →  MONSOONIQ_PROFILE=real make train evaluate console serve
